title: Quest with stages for the journal

region.description: The heading the journal's Other tab files the quest under (story/quest_regions.gd ORDER: a location region id, or companions).

kind.description: main: the story's spine, under the journal's Main tab. Anything else (side and companion quests) is under Other.

closes.description: Rules that end the quest without a line or a fight saying so (story/quest_closures.gd, side quest failure plan F1): it is swept after a conversation or a fight, when the clock moves, on arrival, as the party leaves a region, and on load.

stage.description: The ending the rule moves the quest to: a stage of this quest that ends it (usually a failure; a quiet success is allowed).

when.description: A condition (docs/contracts/dialogue.md; empty is always true): a clock (quest_days.<id> >= 3, days_since.<flag> >= 2), the world's state, or both.

from.description: The open stages the rule applies to (default: every open stage of the quest).

leave.description: A region id: the rule fires only as the party leaves that region, with `when` holding.

warn.description: The journal's amber line while the quest stands at a stage the rule applies to.

warn_when.description: A condition the warning also waits for (the danger has shown itself), else it shows at once.

old_saves.description: Also run when a save loads, for a stuck state an earlier version let a party reach (journal only, no notice). Clocks and departures never run on load.

hint.description: What to do next at this stage, for the journal's Hint button: the place and the person or action, never the twist. Every stage that doesn't end the quest has one (make validate).

then.description: On a stage that ends in failure: the stages the quest may still move to afterwards, its comebacks. Without `then`, a failure is final: StoryState.set_quest_stage refuses every move out of it (side quest failure plan, F1).
